answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding every identity to a stake vault whose deposit is slashed if a shared device fingerprint appears twice. Each epoch a random signal broadcasts a fresh challenge seed, and registration must chain a puzzle to it, so forging many agents costs linear, non-parallel time. Fakes hiding in the nebula of real agents are flushed out when duplicate hardware drains their vaults, pricing mass fraud beyond any attacker's reach.
